subject.title: fix(agents): truncate tool results before overflow compaction

question: Should generic tool-heavy context overflows persistently truncate qualifying tool results before attempting semantic compaction by default?
rationale: Both orders are technically valid but preserve different user value: truncation-first avoids long blocking compaction calls, while compaction-first may retain more semantic detail from raw tool output; tests and CI cannot choose that session-state policy.

options.title: Accept truncation-first and document it
options.body: Land the pressure-qualified truncation-first behavior with compaction fallback and update the public compaction documentation to match.

options.title: Narrow the trigger further
options.body: Require a stronger reduction estimate or another explicit condition before allowing persistent truncation to precede compaction.

options.title: Keep compaction-first
options.body: Close or redesign this PR if semantic preservation should remain the default despite the reported timeout latency.

recommendation.title: Accept truncation-first and document it
recommendation.body: Land the pressure-qualified truncation-first behavior with compaction fallback and update the public compaction documentation to match.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the existing compaction-first overflow recovery and truncation fallback ordering.
